4068-5078-5243-8171.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2445-5254-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-5254-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-6073--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3738-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3738-6972-8095.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

728-3912-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

277-2557-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-2557-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2841-6156-7885.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-7885.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

856-2438-4321-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2438-4321-6277.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

3525-6723-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
997-6972-7233.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1409-4716-5921.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-2510-6707.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
321-399-2475-2510-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2854-4574-4708-6766.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4574-4708-6766.description:
Cast Dark Sphere either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

413-1315-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-1315-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-1315-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4222-5159-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-5159-6788.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Solar Array that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform with haste.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-5159-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Mishra's Warform for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

413-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
413-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

2060-3525-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2060-3525-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

2843-5686-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2843-5686-6553.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3259-4885--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4885--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3204-4359-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4359-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-1168-1479-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1168-1479-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Toggo and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-1849-3967.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1849-3967.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2191-3037-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Activate Gauntlets of Chaos by paying {5} and sacrificing it, exchanging control of Altanak and target creature an opponent controls.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2035-2523-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2092-2742-4949.notablePrerequisites:
Duergar Mine-Captain does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-2742-4949.description:
Activate Duergar Mine-Captain by tapping it, adding {R/W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Duergar Mine-Captain by paying {R/W} and untapping it, giving attacking creatures +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

215-2557-4050-4729-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
215-2557-4050-4729-5176.description:
Cast Myr Enforcer by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Myr Enforcer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

696-2645-2872-3094.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least seven charge counters on it.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
696-2645-2872-3094.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least seven {B}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

985-3459-4474-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

914-2232-4980-5037.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2232-4980-5037.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Blazing Rootwalla from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Anje by tapping it and discarding Blazing Rootwalla into exile.
Blazing Rootwalla's madness ability and Anje trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Blazing Rootwalla enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anje trigger from step 6, untapping it.
Resolve the Anje ability from step 5, causing you to draw a card.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

767-3398.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six other creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
767-3398.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and six other creatures you control as attackers, triggering Druids' Repository seven times and Hellkite Charger.
Resolve all Druids' Repository triggers, putting seven charge counters on it.
Activate Druids' Repository seven times by removing seven charge counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

769-2440-4963.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
769-2440-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
The next time you would draw a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Mana Echoes and Mentor of the Meek trigger.
Allow Mana Echoes to resolve first, adding {C} for each bear you control.
Before Mentor of the Meek resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite bears and colorless mana.

1308-2034-5189.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1308-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

2882-4675-4694-5040.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-5040.description:
Cast Mox Jet by paying {0}.
Mox Jet enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Mox Jet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
